tests.scope: Actual LX7 S32I/L32I guest instructions drive GPIO matrix,I2C/RMT/SPI MMIO; checks correct and incorrect routes, absent-address NACK, RTC date rollover/STOP, resets, source-bounded capacities and no inherited display.

limitations: Bare controller contains no HUB75 panel and has no framebuffer. RTC/codec control and native1-bit SDMMC subset only; QMI8658/SHTC3, audio PCM, physical panel and original manufacturer demo startup unverified.

Manufacturer Test.bin is a complete board demonstration image, but the fetched guide does not establish that exact binary as factory shipping firmware. Keep role=project; no factory identity inferred from partition label.
Native source-bounded subset only. No original factory boot, browser/WebGL or physical hardware validation claimed.
